description: This is a React component source file for a Next.js frontend application named App.tsx. It manages user interactions for uploading documents, generating and viewing AI-driven personas, and orchestrating backend API calls related to persona creation, updates, and state management. It includes various UI components, state handling logic, API integrations, and effects for fetching and syncing persona data based on backend orchestration responses.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Type defining the various states of the application workflow: 'initial', 'processing', 'draft', 'finalized'.

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Interface representing a user's experience entry with id, role, company, date, and description.

classes.name: CareerHighlight
classes.description: Interface representing a career highlight with optional source experience.

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: Interface describing the structure of persona information including name, title, summary, skills, experiences, education, certifications, tools, industries, years of experience, and career highlights.

classes.name: UploadedFileData
classes.description: Interface for uploaded files with id and file object.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown input into a string array, filtering out non-string or empty values.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null, non-empty object.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Derives initials from a label string for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely navigates nested objects using a path array, returning value and path used.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs top-level and nested keys within orchestration payload for debugging.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON and source path from orchestration response, prioritizing certain envelope locations and pattern checks.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the frontend's PersonaData structure, supporting multiple backend shapes.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing persona creation workflow, including document upload, state transitions, API interaction, and rendering different UI states.
